title: Algorithmic Win: Count Once
prompt: `sumUnique` returns the sum of distinct values. The naive version sorts and scans, or worse, is O(n²). Implement it to run in **at most n long-long comparisons** by using an unordered_set — the grader counts comparisons via a tracked type.

tests.name: correct sums
tests.hint: Insert everything into std::unordered_set<Tracked>, adding t.value when the insert is new.

tests.name: no sorting-based comparisons
tests.hint: unordered_set compares only when a duplicate lands in an occupied bucket — at most n comparisons; a sort-based approach needs O(n log n) and fails the bound.
